clean_description: American Pastoral follows Seymour 'Swede' Levov, a successful businessman and former high school athlete, whose idyllic life in post-war America unravels during the social upheaval of the 1960s. As his daughter becomes involved in radical political activism, Swede grapples with the loss of his American dream and the disintegration of his family. The novel explores themes of identity, societal change, and the complexities of the American experience.
